name: edit-transaction-rollback
note: The first operation of the transaction is applicable and the second one is not: its old text matches twice. The task pins that a partly applicable transaction writes nothing at all — the file the first operation would have rewritten stays byte-identical to the seed — and that the refusal reaches the model as a tool result instead of failing the turn.
prompt: bump the value in first.py and rename the marker in second.py
